title: Dot product of a fixed-coordinate frequency lift
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $J$ be a subset of its coordinate indices, and let $\gamma$ be a binary vector indexed by the complement of $J$, in the enumeration used to order that complement. For every binary vector $x$ of length $n$, the dot product of the fixed-coordinate frequency lift of $\gamma$ with $x$ equals the dot product of $\gamma$ with the restriction of $x$ to the complement of $J$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite set $J$ of coordinate indices in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
A binary vector indexed by the enumerated complement of $J$
